t:
(a) Designation.—The facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1351 2nd Street in Napa, California, shall be known and designated as the “Tom Kongsgaard Post Office Building”. 
    (b) References.—Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the facility referred to in subsection (a) shall be deemed to be a reference to the “Tom Kongsgaard Post Office Building”.

fable.w: This section only names a post office building and says how existing references to it should be read. The tempting reading is that the word "regulation" signals rulemaking, but here it is just one item in a boilerplate list of records and gives no agency authority to issue rules. No one outside the federal government is consulted, heard, or given a right to challenge any federal decision.
fable.s: Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the facility referred to in subsection (a) shall be deemed to be a reference to the “Tom Kongsgaard Post Office Building”.

opus.w: This section only names a Postal Service building and says that existing references to it mean the new name. No one outside the federal government is consulted or involved in any decision. The word "regulation" appears only in a list of documents that refer to the building. The section does not give anyone power to make rules, so it is not participation.
opus.b: 1. **Reasoning:** One might be tempted by the word "regulation" in subsection (b), since giving an agency power to make regulations counts as participation. That reading fails. The word appears only in a list of existing records that must refer to the building by its new name. The section gives no one authority to make rules, and it involves no consultation, hearing, advisory body or right to sue. It simply names a post office.

qwen_chat.w: This section simply designates a name for a federal facility. It does not require or recommend any consultation, coordination, or participation with people outside the federal government. The decision is made unilaterally by the statute itself.
qwen_chat.s: The facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1351 2nd Street in Napa, California, shall be known and designated as the “Tom Kongsgaard Post Office Building”.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that naming a building after a person involves some form of public recognition or consultation, but the text itself contains no procedural requirement for outside parties to participate in the decision. The designation is made directly by statute.
